examples.arabic: ابتسم واقول مساء الخير كيف حالك
examples.english: I smile and say good evening how are you.
examples.transliteration: abtasimu wa-aqulu masa al-khayr kayfa haluka.

examples.arabic: قال طارق السلام عليكم مساء الخير
examples.english: Tariq said peace be upon you good evening
examples.transliteration: Qala Tariq as-salamu alaykum masa al-khayr

examples.arabic: راى خالد شرطيا وقال له مساء الخير كيف حالك
examples.english: Khalid saw a policeman and said to him good evening how are you.
examples.transliteration: raa khalid shurtiyan wa qala lahu masa al khayr kayfa haluka

examples.arabic: ذهبت إلى المقهى كعادتي فسمعت صوتا مألوفا يقول السلام عليكم صباح الخير
examples.english: I went to the cafe as usual and heard a familiar voice saying hello good morning
examples.transliteration: Dhahabtu ila al maqha ka adati fa samitu sawtan malufan yaqul as salamu alaykum sabah al khayr
examples.storyTitle: A Surprise Meeting at the Cafe

examples.english: He meets the seller and says good evening.
examples.transliteration: Yuqabilu al bai wa yaqulu masa al khayr
